svg.title: 3D Scene Understanding and Interaction: research roadmap

cc:Work.dc:title: 3D Scene Understanding and Interaction: research roadmap
cc:Work.dc:description: A map of scene perception, whole-scene reconstruction, scene generation, robotic interaction, embodied agents, and shared evaluation resources.

svg.desc: Five research lanes branch into subtopics, strategies, and linked representative papers: scene perception, articulated geometry, generation and authoring, manipulation, and embodied agents and evaluation. Shared resources cover real scenes, articulated assets and physics, functional supervision, and robot-task benchmarks.
